Acme's payout of 54385 is recorded and matches its orders (73072) minus its refund on order 203 (18687). Birch's net balance of 40147 matches its orders (44020) minus its refund on order 201 (3873), so I'll record that payout next.
Acme (54385) and birch (40147) are paid. Cobalt's orders total 30107 + 2972 = 33079 with no refunds, which matches its net balance, so I'll record its payout now.
All three payouts were recorded successfully. Each matches its order total minus refunds: acme 73072 - 18687 = 54385, birch 44020 - 3873 = 40147, cobalt 30107 + 2972 = 33079. The batch is complete.
